Header: Tilletia caries Wheat Bunt/ Wheat covered smut

Prevention: Use the right amount of seed 140-150kg per hectare.
Irrigate in the winter to cool the land and keep it humid.
Use clean and disease- free seed.
Monitoring: Monitoring should be done once a week.
Infected plants are shorter than healthy ones.They also have blackened heads and do not look healthy.
Infected spikes are light in weight.
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Collect infected plants and bury them in the soil.
Seed treatment with warm water for 10 minutes: heat water until it is just hot enough to put your hand in (about 50 degrees).
If it is too hot, it will kill the seed.
Diseased plants need to be identified early, removed and destroyed by burning.
Spikelets in a diseased ear gap open to reveal black masses.
They can cause the whole head to blacken at a late stage.
By then it is too late to remove the disease, and it will already have affected the plant.
Direct Control (Chemical): Keep pesticides out of reach of children.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage
prevent children and animals from entering the field and do not eat drink or smoke whilst using chemicals of any kind.
Change your clothes and wash your body and face after using chemicals.
In humid bags, place mixture and seeds, and shake to mix properly.
This should be done one week before the sowing.
